title: fix: blank itinerary days on multi-day trips
body:
## Summary
- **Uncapped `maxActivities`** from 10 to `expectedDays * 6` — the cap of 10 caused activity IDs on later days to be silently dropped during normalization, leaving days with only a dinner recommendation
- **Fixed `expectedDays` off-by-one** — added inclusive `+ 1` to match the prompt's counting (Jun 1–3 = 3 days, not 2), preventing the last day from being sliced off

## Test plan
- [x] All 350 tests pass (`npm test`)
- [x] Updated trim test to expect correct inclusive day count
- [ ] Manual: run a 7+ day Japan trip and verify all days have 4-6 activities
